mentions.name: BacklogAI
mentions.description: This is an AI-powered autopilot engineer for SaaS teams that connects to GitHub, CI, Sentry, and Linear and takes tickets all the way to production. Claude writes the code changes while the tool handles tests, migrations, feature flags, and staged rollouts, clearing months of backlog work in hours. It also automatically fixes production bugs with a bug fix agent.
mentions.problem: SaaS teams accumulate months of engineering backlog, and hiring more developers is expensive.
mentions.source_excerpt:
